title: Native visual feedback reply through invalidation
description: Use only the owned Android emulator and private proof gateway. A localhost proxy selected through that emulator's adb reverse tunnel holds one real terminal.send refusal for a uniquely owned run whose slot does not exist. It forwards every other response unchanged. The actual UI types and sends feedback, a second client updates the run, and the held response is delivered byte-for-byte. The reverse mapping, native connection, temporary run and task are restored. No live worker receives input and no UI/cache state is injected.

proofTargets.claim: A pending actual terminal.send reply survives same-connection run invalidation without resetting the native draft or delivery state.
The actual Send button stays disabled while its real response is withheld through invalidation.
The unchanged real gateway refusal settles the original delivery on the same native runtime and connection, with exactly one wire request.

before.intent: Open the owned Android device session before the transport-boundary proof.

prove.intent: Hold a real reply, invalidate the observed run and deliver the same response without replay.

pending.intent: Require delivery to remain pending through the actual notification and catch-up reads.

disabled.intent: Require the actual pending Send control to remain disabled.

settled.intent: Require the real refusal, equal response digests and one actual request.
